title: How to be seen: optimizing your manuscript for AI search
content: The way the world searches for scientific advances and toxicological information has fundamentally changed. Just 5 years ago, a risk assessor evaluating a novel substitute chemical, or a clinician researching an acute poisoning would have entered a Boolean search string into databases such as PubMed or Google Scholar. They would then scan down a list of titles and blue links, read the abstracts, and manually synthesize the information they had found.
